package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_runtime_configuration_reflection_config_loaded_per_call: Layer: Build and runtime configuration. Flag reflection-based config decoding performed per operation instead of at startup.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type scenario588Config struct {
	Host string
	Port int
}

func scenario588Positive(config *scenario588Config, fieldName string) (any, error) {
	v := reflect.ValueOf(config).Elem()
	f := v.FieldByName(fieldName)
	if !f.IsValid() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("field %q not found", fieldName)
	}
	return f.Interface(), nil
}

func scenario588Resolve(config *scenario588Config) string {
	host, _ := scenario588Positive(config, "Host")
	port, _ := scenario588Positive(config, "Port")
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", host, port)
}
